name: get_material
description: Fetch trade materials by name, INCI or CAS (query) or by id (materialId) with their sourced properties and dated price quotes. Each value carries its source and confidence level (L1 best to L7 estimate). A material with no price is reported in missing.

query.description: Part of the trade name, grade, INCI or CAS.

materialId.description: The id of one trade material.

name: calculate_formula
description: Deterministic engine: the material cost per kg of a saved formula version (formulaVersionId) or of a what-if list of lines (materialId and percentWW as decimal strings). Returns each line cost with the price quote used (source, confidence, date), the total, and whatever is missing (a material with no usable price is reported, never costed as zero). Give either formulaVersionId or lines.

formulaVersionId.description: The id of a saved formula version.

lines.description: A what-if formula, percent w/w per material as decimal strings.

name: optimize_tier
description: Least-cost LP (HiGHS) for a product type and tier (economy, mid, premium) from the stored tier profile and the listed available materials. Deterministic. Returns a DRAFT formula with cost per kg and the binding constraints, or why it is infeasible, or what is missing (profile, prices, active matter). The formula stays draft until it is tested in the lab.

targetRetailPriceEGP.description: The retail price the user wants, a decimal string, per `per`.

availableMaterialIds.description: Ids of the trade materials the optimizer may use.

name: check_compliance
description: Run the compliance rules (ES, CosIng, IFRA) over a saved formula version. Returns PASS, FAIL or UNKNOWN per rule with the value, the limit and the rule source; UNKNOWN means data is missing (see missing), it is never a pass.

formulaVersionId.description: The id of a saved formula version.

name: soap_lye
description: Saponification lye and water with purity and SAP range.

name: neutralize_labsa
description: NaOH needed for LABSA from COA acid value and NaOH purity.

name: convert_units
description: Convert a value between units: kg/g/mg, L/mL, %v/v to %w/w for ethanol (OIML R 22 table), mass to volume (needs materialId with a sourced density, or densityGml given by the user), and EGP to or from another currency (needs fxDate, YYYY-MM-DD). Units are written exactly: kg, g, mg, L, mL, %v/v, %w/w, EGP, USD.

materialId.description: Its sourced density is used for mass and volume conversion.

densityGml.description: A density in g/mL given by the user, when no material is named.

fxDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day of the exchange rate for a currency conversion.

name: explain_result
description: Explain how far an earlier tool answer of this conversation turn can be trusted: its sources, their confidence levels (L1 best, L7 estimate), the weakest level, values below L2 and what is missing. Call it after another tool when the user asks why or how sure.

name: extract_coa
description: Report the draft of a certificate of analysis (COA) that was uploaded and read, by extractionId. The values are an UNCONFIRMED reading (L7): a person must confirm each one on the review screen before it is saved (then L1) and before any calculation can use it. Never present a draft value as data. missing lists what the document did not give.

extractionId.description: The id of the uploaded and read COA.

name: landed_cost
description: Allocate freight, insurance, duty, clearance, transport and finance charges over a receipt's lines. Deterministic; returns landed cost per stock unit with trace.

name: packaging_bom
description: Packaging cost per unit for a SKU from its BOM, reject rates, carton/pallet shares and amortized one-time costs.

name: unit_cost
description: Full unit cost: landed materials + overfill + packaging + conversion + QA/regulatory, with trace per line.

name: price_waterfall
description: Cost to shelf price (forward) or shelf price to maximum allowable cost (reverse), using dated tax regime.

name: fragrance_blend
description: Fine fragrance / air care calc: fragrance oil %, ethanol dilution via OIML R22 tables, water, IFRA limit check for the product category, maceration loss.

name: emulsion_phases
description: Emulsion formula by phases with functional classes, required HLB of oil phase, emulsifier blend, frame-formulation and preservative limits.
